name: Lemon Squeezy
summary: Lemon Squeezy is a payment platform for selling software online that acts as merchant of record, handling sales tax and VAT for you.

free_plan_covers.note: No monthly fee or user cap; you only pay per transaction (5% + 50 cents, tax handling included).

first_paid_usd_month.note: No monthly plan; pricing is pay-per-transaction, with no separate paid tier to unlock.

portability.note: Proprietary checkout and merchant-of-record relationship; moving away needs a rebuild of billing and tax setup.

merchant_of_record.note: Lemon Squeezy is merchant of record on every sale. Official pricing page blocked automated fetch; confirmed via secondary sources.

subscriptions.note: Recurring subscription billing is supported, with an extra 0.5% fee added to subscription charges.

fee_summary.note: Flat rate for every seller. Sourced from secondary sites since lemonsqueezy.com/pricing returned 403 to automated fetch.

card_fee_percent.note: Lemon Squeezy keeps 5% of each US card payment, as listed on its pricing page.

card_fee_fixed_usd.note: On top of the percent, Lemon Squeezy keeps $0.50 from each US card payment.

setup.step: Create a Lemon Squeezy account and a store.
Create an API key from your account's API settings page.
Install the official SDK with npm install @lemonsqueezy/lemonsqueezy.js.
Set your API key and store ID as environment variables that only the server can read.
Create a webhook pointed at a webhook route in your app, set a signing secret, and verify the X-Signature header on incoming events.

builder_notes: Keep LEMONSQUEEZY_API_KEY on the server only; never give it a prefix that makes it readable in the browser.
Verify the X-Signature header on every webhook before trusting it.
Stripe acquired Lemon Squeezy and is steering users to Stripe Managed Payments; confirm it is still actively onboarding new stores before committing to it.
